senses.gloss: whorl of the spindle (vorticulus), also shuttle (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Tela).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 8:6">Sabb. VIII, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 81a:1">81ᵃ</cite>) <he>ראש הכ׳</he> (Y. ed. a. Mish. Pes. <he>הכרכד</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) the top of the whorl; Y. ib. XVII, 16ᵇ. Bab. ib. 123ᵃ <he>תוחכין בכוש או בכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>בכַרְכִּיר</he>) you stick it up with a reed or a whorl; Y. l. c. top. Tosef. ib. IX (X) 10; <cite ref="Shabbat 92b">Sabb. 92ᵇ</cite>; Sifra Vayikra, Ḥobah, ch. IX, Par. 7, v. <cite ref="L00124"><he>לָגַז</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 96:2">Sifré Deut. 96</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 3:9">Ab. Zar. III, 9</cite> (<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 49b:3">49ᵇ</cite>) <he>נטל הימנה כ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="K01202"><he>כַּרְכּוֹר</he></cite>, Var. <cite ref="K00633"><he>כִּירְכּוּר</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) if one took from it (the Asherah) a piece to use it as a shuttle; a. fr.

senses.gloss: [turner,] a rod used for shaking olives down.
